scope: Source-reviewed record relationships only. Unlisted pairs are unassessed; these annotations do not establish duplicate sample identities.
disclaimer: Shared portals, hosting, and reported cell reuse are different. Do not infer duplicate batteries, merge cohorts, or combine train/test partitions without verifying cell-level identifiers and study provenance.

relationships.label: Shared repository portal
relationships.description: Both entries link to data.matr.io/1/ and reference related MIT–Stanford–TRI fast-charging research. A shared portal is not proof that the experiments used identical cells. Trace study, batch and cell IDs before combining them.

relationships.label: Hosted within umbrella portal
relationships.description: Battery Archive is the umbrella portal hosting the Sandia commercial-cell degradation study. The portal and constituent dataset are not two independent experimental cohorts.

relationships.label: Reported reuse of aged cells
relationships.description: The second-life study describes six 21700 cells previously aged under EV-driving profiles. Treat these as potentially linked experimental histories; verify original cell identifiers before cross-study splits or pooling.
